scope: Proposed fixed small synthetic WebGL2 target cases; tolerances do not guarantee arbitrary-input image error or device support.

scene.gaussians: identity orientation, isotropic scale0.3 unless overridden, meanXY0, original degree4 complete table
scene.sample: center pixel(128,128), RGBA8 after final IEC output
scene.background: opaque Mesh plane z=-0.5, linear RGB per case
